topic: From no work experience to a story every college essay needs
caption:
College essays ask for a moment that changed you.
Most teens are still waiting for that moment to happen.
HustleUp helps your teen build one this summer, one real skill and one real paycheck at a time.
Give them a head start → hustleup.us
